people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.
translations.bsb: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So they embalmed him,
translations.kjv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
